provenance.source: Infest01..04.run, every vehicle damage call 004212F0 whose 0047C6E0 came from the terrain response 0047D2F0 (impacts0N.txt, path=terrain)
provenance.vehicle: the vehicle's bytes +000..+5FF at the response's entry (the last 0047D2F0 execution before the damage call)
provenance.contact: the five DWORDs 0047D2F0 reads: flag, normal X/Y/Z (floats), displacement
provenance.after: position +32..+36, velocity +8E..+92 and health +A0 when the damage call returned
provenance.damage: 004212F0's damage argument (0047C6E0's adjusted damage); packet: the DWORD at its packet argument
